name: Low-vol anomaly tilt — hold the calm names (1d, spot)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: the low-volatility ANOMALY as a persistent HOLDING tilt, NOT a momentum gate. Fresh 2025-2026 evidence (review of the low-vol anomaly in crypto, 432 coins on Binance spot, Jan-2018 to Nov-2025) finds low-realized-vol coins deliver BETTER risk-adjusted returns because leverage-constrained / leverage-averse crypto retail crowds into high-vol lottery names (perp OI >$115B Q1-2025) and overpays for them, structurally underpricing the boring low-vol names. Entry: vol_realized below a fitted ceiling (a genuinely calm name) AND atr below a fitted ceiling (independent low-range confirmation) AND range_position not at the top of its band (not buying a local high). Hold the low-vol regime through calm; the position rides the persistent premium the leverage-hungry crowd leaves on the table. The other side is the degen buying the high-beta lottery ticket; the constraint (can't lever the safe name to target return) is why the mispricing persists and isn't arbed. Crucially the cited study is SPOT-only to strip funding/leverage confounds — so we test on SPOT (no funding leg). Exit: vol_realized crosses up out of the calm band (the name is no longer low-vol -> tilt no longer applies) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if the low-vol basket's excess return vanishes once fees + a buy-and-hold BTC benchmark are subtracted (the Gate's beat-B&H leg), the anomaly is disguised beta to calm large-caps and there is no orthogonal premium. DISCONFIRMER 2: if a HIGH-vol tilt does equally well over the same sample, the sign is unstable -> curve-fit. NOTE it's a slow tilt -> tension with the sniper mandate; include only if it clears B&H net.
catalyst: a persistently calm low-vol name the leverage-averse crowd underprices
